_comment: Independent public-input witness for win/tty/getline.c xwaitforspace() lines 244-252 through wintty.c dmore() with msg_window:reversed: a Barbarian escapes the engraving --More--, which stores 1 in ttyDisplay->dismiss_more, cancels the text prompt and opens the discoveries window. Its first page refuses ^P and turns on ^A (1); Escape closes the second page. A ^P then shows the reversed history window, whose tty_doprev_message() arm clears dismiss_more (topl.c:100) once space dismisses it, so the reopened discoveries window refuses ^A and turns its page on space.
